strings.world.vekta.name: Vekta
strings.world.vekta.text: The ISA home world: temperate fields, cities and coast.
strings.world.helghan.name: Helghan
strings.world.helghan.text: The Helghast home world: ash plains, storms and refineries.
strings.world.halcyon.name: Halcyon
strings.world.halcyon.text: A low-gravity moon of craters, with ISA mining outposts.
strings.world.morrow.name: Morrow
strings.world.morrow.text: A moon of penal mines and thin air, worked by Helghast labour camps.
strings.world.bastion.name: Bastion Station
strings.world.bastion.text: The ISA orbital dock that builds and repairs ships and guards Vekta.
strings.world.ardent.name: Ardent Platform
strings.world.ardent.text: The Helghast arc defence station guarding Helghan.
strings.world.midway.name: Midway Relay
strings.world.midway.text: A neutral deep-space station: the chokepoint of the war.
strings.world.kerberos.name: Kerberos Belt
strings.world.kerberos.text: A neutral asteroid colony, rich in fuel ore, waiting to be claimed.
strings.scenario.balanced_war.name: Balanced war
strings.scenario.balanced_war.text: Each side holds its home world, a moon and a station; Midway and Kerberos wait in between.

strings.unit.isa_destroyer.text: An escort that fights other ships.

strings.unit.isa_intruder.text: Dropships that land an army group anywhere enemy anti-air does not cover.
strings.unit.isa_transport.name: ISA transport
strings.unit.isa_transport.text: Carries two army groups between worlds but cannot fight.

strings.unit.helghast_transport.text: Carries two army groups between worlds but cannot fight.

strings.improvement.trench.name: Trench line
strings.improvement.trench.text: +4 defence, and a zone of control even when empty: the enemy stops when it comes next to it.
strings.improvement.wire.name: Sandbags and razor wire
strings.improvement.wire.text: An enemy that walks in loses the rest of its moves.
strings.improvement.mg_nest.name: Machine gun nest
strings.improvement.mg_nest.text: +2 defence, and a free shot at the first enemy that stops beside it each turn.
strings.improvement.bunker.name: Bunker
strings.improvement.bunker.text: +8 defence; the garrison takes half damage from orbital strikes and artillery.
strings.improvement.artillery_battery.name: Artillery battery
strings.improvement.artillery_battery.text: With one of your units standing in it, shells the nearest enemy within 3 hexes each turn.
strings.improvement.anti_air_battery.name: Anti-air battery
strings.improvement.anti_air_battery.text: No enemy drop zone or orbital strike within 2 hexes.
strings.improvement.arc_tower.name: Arc tower
strings.improvement.arc_tower.text: Helghast only: arcs hit every enemy beside it each turn.
strings.improvement.minefield.name: Minefield
strings.improvement.minefield.text: Hidden from the enemy; the first of them to walk in sets it off.
strings.improvement.landing_bay.name: Landing bay
strings.improvement.landing_bay.text: Army groups land here from orbit without dropships; supplies 2 hexes.
strings.improvement.supply_depot.name: Supply depot
strings.improvement.supply_depot.text: Supplies every hex your side holds within 3.
strings.improvement.command_post.name: Forward command post
strings.improvement.command_post.text: Supplies every hex your side holds within 3.
strings.improvement.field_hospital.name: Field hospital
strings.improvement.field_hospital.text: Your units here heal 20 more each turn.
strings.improvement.comms_relay.name: Comms relay
strings.site.reactor.name: Reactor
strings.site.reactor.text: The heart of a station: whoever holds it holds the station.
